<!-- All news items below this line -->{{Current events|year=2004|month=02|day=14|content=

* A new U.S.-sponsored satellite TV channel called [[Alhurra]] (''The Free One'') begins broadcasting in the Middle East and pledges to provide accurate and balanced news, but faces a skeptical [[Arab]] audience.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://news.myway.com/world/article/id/385434%7Cworld%7C02-15-2004::10:26%7Creuters.html|title=My Way - News|work=myway.com|accessdate=6 October 2015}}</ref>
* [[Marco Pantani]], world-renowned [[cyclist]], winner of the 1998 [[Tour de France]] and the 1998 [[Giro d'Italia]], is found dead in a hotel in the Adriatic city of [[Rimini]], Italy.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2004/02/16/sports/othersports/16BIKE.html?8hpib |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-12-20 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141017035252/http://www.nytimes.com/2004/02/16/sports/othersports/16BIKE.html?8hpib |archive-date=2014-10-17 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* [[Same-sex marriage in the United States]]: Staff advisors for U.S. President [[George W. Bush]] say he will support the proposed [[Federal Marriage Amendment]] to the [[U.S. Constitution]] which would outlaw [[same-sex marriage]] and federalize marriage law, which has been set by individual [[U.S. state|states]] since the founding of the country.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.advocate.com/new_news.asp?ID=11313&sd=02%2F14%2F04-02%2F17%2F04 |title=Archived copy |access-date=2019-07-29 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070930180529/http://www.advocate.com/new_news.asp?ID=11313&sd=02%2F14%2F04-02%2F17%2F04 |archive-date=2007-09-30 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/articles/A36929-2004Feb12.html |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-12-20 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121103102335/http://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/articles/A36929-2004Feb12.html |archive-date=2012-11-03 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* U.S. President hopeful [[John Kerry]] scores two more [[United States Democratic Party|Democrat]]ic primary victories in  the State of [[Nevada]] and the federally controlled [[District of Columbia]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://apnews.myway.com//article/20040215/D80NEIQG0.html|title=My Way|work=myway.com|accessdate=6 October 2015}}</ref>
* In Moscow, a roof collapses killing about 25 and injuring at least 110.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://news.myway.com/world/article/id/385363%7Cworld%7C02-15-2004::12:08%7Creuters.html|title=My Way - News|work=myway.com|accessdate=6 October 2015}}</ref>
* Approximately 550 qualified candidates suddenly drop out of [[Iran]]'s parliamentary election.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://news.myway.com/world/article/id/123049%7Cworld%7C02-14-2004::14:29%7Creuters.html|title=My Way - News|work=myway.com|accessdate=6 October 2015}}</ref>
* [[American occupation of Iraq|Occupation of Iraq]]: At least 20 people are killed in the town of [[Falluja]] as up to 50 gunmen attack government buildings, in one of the largest guerrilla attacks so far seen in [[Iraq]].<ref>{{cite news| url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/world/middle_east/3488149.stm | work=BBC News | title=Gunmen go on rampage in Iraq town | date=February 14, 2004}}</ref>
* [[ROC presidential election, 2004]]: Candidates [[Lien Chan]] of the [[Pan-Blue Coalition]] and President [[Chen Shui-bian]] of the [[Pan-Green Coalition]] participate in a televised debate.<ref>{{cite news| url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/asia-pacific/3487947.stm | work=BBC News | first=Chris | last=Hogg | title=Taiwan rivals in historic debate | date=February 14, 2004}}</ref>
* [[Disney Channel]] airs the last episode of ''[[Lizzie McGuire]]'' called "[[Magic Train]]".
